body:
Ordered some pure JWH-018.  Read a few reports. Did not have any scales, so dipped the tip of a knife in powder ...tapped the knife until I had about 10 or so 'salt grains' left and put that in my pipe ...on top of some herb I had.
It took two hits to clear.  Immediately felt the onset of being mildly high.  Watched some TV for about an hour ...the creep of the JWH-018 was very slow, so I convinced myself that I needed another dose.  So after an hour fifteen minutes I had my second dose ready ...which was about 15-20 grains.
Another 2 hits to clear bowl.  5 minutes in, I was sitting down and I realized this was too much.  I didn't panic or anything like that -- my heart rate was normal -- I felt like I had eaten too many brownies (pot brownies).  I started feeling some motion sickness (though not as bad as seasick or even car sick).  2hrs from first dose, I was splashing water on my face to get my shit back together.
2.5 hrs in ...I was not hallucinating but my eyes seemed very dry and tired ...so I was seeing double.  I decided to nap on the couch.
3 hrs in ...still napping comfortably
3.5 hrs in ...woke up from nap ...felt a lot better but was still way too high.
3.5 hrs in ...woke up from nap ...felt a lot better but was still way too high.
I was able to make some supper and ate some hot sandwiches.
4 hrs in ...I was slightly less high (almost where I needed to be) -- but extremely tired.
4.5 hrs in ...I went to bed.
I slept like a baby and did not feel 'hungover' -- in fact, it was the best sleep I've had in two weeks.
I would keep to a single dose of around 5-10 mg (or grains).  I am a heavy smoker of about 18 yrs (not cigs) - so I naturally thought I could handle more.  I could not.
JWH-018 --- CREEPS.  I would say there is an initial slight high, but it really takes 1.5 or more hours to really gauge if you need more.  You probably do not.
Too much is NOT fun ...the only thing to do was sleep it off (after I ate).
